{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnaflare pole''' was a portable illumination device. During a [[draagax]] hunt organized by [[Jameson]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Relkass]], [[Grendles]] carried a magnaflare pole until he was killed by a draagax.<ref name= "CG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
